statement: 本批由辅助调度器实现，非独立实现方；验收须由他方完成。
purpose: Record the prompt version and both prompt digests that BATCH-28's live repair ran under, together with the values they supersede. BATCH-11's own prompt-manifest.json is historical evidence for BATCH-11 and was deliberately not rewritten.

supersedes.note: that file still records the v1 pair because it is BATCH-11's record of what BATCH-11 delivered; it has no consumers in the repository and was left byte-identical

hash_method.what_is_hashed: sha256 of the prompt string as the module holds it (UTF-8), i.e. prompt_manifest()['candidate_prompt_sha256'] and ['schema_repair_prompt_sha256']
hash_method.why_line_endings_do_not_matter: Python normalises source newlines when it parses a module, so a CRLF checkout and an LF blob hash alike
hash_method.self_check: the superseded v1 pair was re-derived from the committed v1 module (git show f76dd1c3:backend/src/covenia_b/model/prompts/candidate_extraction.py) and reproduced the recorded v1 values exactly, which validates the method before it was used on v2

why_the_version_was_bumped.trigger: every live extraction of BATCH-28 was refused by the server-side source validator with MISSING_FIELD_TRACE: the model traced observations[0..n] and never traced candidate_promise_texts[0..m], while source_validation.py:103-111 requires one trace per observation and one per promise
ambiguity_removed: the JSON example showed a single literal field value, "observations[0] or candidate_promise_texts[0]", which the model could read as one trace per observation only; the example now shows three concrete entries with concrete indices and no "or"
both prompt bodies now state the rule operationally: "Emit one source_trace entry per observation and one per candidate promise; a single entry never covers two fields."
why_the_version_was_bumped.settings_sync_requirement: covenia_b.runtime:589 compares settings.model_prompt_version with prompt_manifest()['prompt_version'] and raises RuntimeConfigurationError on a mismatch, so backend/src/covenia_b/settings.py:56 was moved to candidate-extraction-v2 in the same commit
why_the_version_was_bumped.manifest_source: prompt_manifest() is computed in memory (runtime.py:588, tools/verification/live_smoke.py:855) and reads no JSON file, so bumping the constant keeps every consumer consistent automatically

commit.subject: fix(prompt): emit one source_trace entry per promise, not only per observation
commit.author: aux-dispatcher <aux@local>

observed_in_live_runs.COVENIA_MODEL_PROMPT_VERSION: NOT_SET (the new default was exercised on purpose)

outcome_under_v2_honest_note: the bump does not make criterion 1 reliable: with this manifest 2 of 9 real attempts produced the missing candidate_promise_texts[0] trace and were accepted (one of them built the ExtractedJourney and the AccountabilityState with cached_result=false and the locked revision), while 7 of 9 repeated the old rejection. The full run log is in reports/batches/BATCH-28/AUX_CROSS_LINE_REPAIR_REPORT.json.
